title: Readiness reflects at least one verified pool
prerequisites: Explicit approval to restart ONLY dedicated QA relay; both pool invalidations must be QA-specific (for example nonexistent QA-only template refs) and restored afterwards.
Probe /readyz and /metrics through a private local forward to QA pod even when Kubernetes refuses service routing to not-ready pod; record both provider/pool labels.
Ensure no QA session in flight, snapshot approved baseline config and healthy gauges before changing it; never alter production credentials or pools.

variants.title: Neither pool verifies

steps.action: Apply nonexistent QA template refs to both pools, restart dedicated relay and probe QA pod /readyz plus agent_relay_pool_healthy every 10s.
steps.expected: After verification settles, HTTP 503 and both labeled gauges 0 with sanitized per-pool verification reasons; not merely a connection failure.
steps.evidence: UTC probe HTTP status/body, two labeled gauges, redacted config hash.

cleanup: Proceed immediately to Q07-b or restore baseline if interrupted; never leave both pools invalid.

variants.title: One healthy pool is ready

steps.action: Restore only Claude QA template, leave Cursor QA ref invalid; restart dedicated relay, probe direct pod every 10s.
steps.expected: HTTP 200, Claude pool gauge 1 and Cursor pool gauge 0 with Cursor verification error. A 200 never means every pool is healthy.
steps.evidence: Labeled gauges, probe status and sanitized per-pool reason.

cleanup: Proceed immediately to Q07-c or restore baseline if interrupted.

variants.title: Both pools recover

steps.action: Restore both QA template refs and restart dedicated relay; poll direct pod probes every 10s.
steps.expected: HTTP 200 and both labeled health gauges 1 after pool verification.
steps.evidence: Redacted config hash, probe status and two labeled gauges.

cleanup: Confirm original QA baseline restored, production untouched and no temporary invalid template refs remain.

notes: Q07-b depends on Q07-a and Q07-c must run before completion. If the invalid reference fails process startup instead of pool verification, mark blocked and investigate without weakening the assertion.
